title: Habit 6: Synergize
coreMove: Synergy starts when difference is valued as data; high trust lets people move past my way and your way toward a third alternative.

exampleSpecs.stakes: two positions may harden into camps
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use disagreement as raw material for a third option

exampleSpecs.stakes: schedule and safety appear to conflict
funders and staff measure success differently
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: build measures that honor both realities

exampleSpecs.stakes: art and engineering may ship a weaker feature
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: blend constraints into a stronger design

exampleSpecs.stakes: drivers and cyclists expect a zero-sum vote
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: turn opposing needs into design criteria
